sources.name: Taipei Exchange OpenAPI
sources.note: TWSE and TPEx are separate markets; Lumen always retains market identity. Missing per-stock institutional categories are shown as missing rather than inferred.

sources.name: MOPS
sources.scope: statutory corporate disclosures, material information and financial reports

sources.name: TAIFEX OpenAPI
sources.interpretation_limit: Institutional categories are aggregates of many institutions and must not be presented as one institution or one unanimous strategy.

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
sources.scope: official U.S. CPI, PPI, employment statistics and release calendar

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
sources.scope: official U.S. GDP, Personal Income and Outlays statistics and release calendar

sources.name: Federal Reserve
sources.scope: official FOMC calendar, statements and monetary policy releases

coverage_contract.security_universe: All securities successfully returned by official TWSE listed and TPEx mainboard daily quote universes remain searchable by code/name with market identity preserved.
coverage_contract.failure_rule: Any required check failure must remain visible and prevents the maintenance run from being labeled healthy/complete.

runtime.latest_data_policy: market-critical endpoints are fetched with no-store on page load and manual refresh
runtime.snapshot_policy: Direct official API remains primary. A cataloged snapshot dataset is used only when the corresponding live dataset is empty, status is explicitly verified, rows are non-empty, frontend_fallback is enabled, and any freshness limit remains valid. Unverified datasets never backfill financial values.
runtime.snapshot_scope: Catalog covers market, listed/OTC quotes, ETF, valuation, margin, TAIFEX, monthly revenue, company profile, material information, TPEx institutional data, TWSE T86 registration, and listed/OTC income-statement and balance-sheet families.
runtime.technical_history: six months of official OHLC when available; fields+data and table response shapes are normalized before indicator calculation
runtime.workspace_local: LocalStorage multi-workspace plus JSON and URL-fragment transfer

workspace_cloud.access: authenticated users only; RLS owner-only select/insert/update/delete
workspace_cloud.merge: last-updated workspace wins during two-way sync

runtime.external_news: discovery only; financial numbers must be re-verified against primary sources

deployment_scope.cloudflare_status_policy: Do not claim lumen-script.pages.dev is synchronized until writable Cloudflare Pages access is verified.
